title: Markaz e Hal Ataa Fatema Fatema
body:
Sayyeda, Fatema, Tahira, Raziya, Marziya
Sayyeda, Fatema, Tahira, Fatema, Fatema
Markaz e hal ataa, Fatema, Fatema..(2)
Aayat e hal ataa, Fatema, Fatema
Markaz e hal ataa, Fatema, Fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Bola suraj palat kar ali ya ali
chand ne di sadaein nabi ya nabi
taara kehta raha Fatema, Fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Waqt e mushkil padhi sab ne nade ali
aur ali par padhi jab bhi mushkil koi
bole mushkil kusha Fatema, Fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hogayi jis ghadi aayatein ek jaa'n
uski nisbat se sab ka ta'arruf hua
roohe ehle kisa Fatema, Fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hogaya shamil e ehlebayt e nabi
baat salman ko jab samajh aagayi
hai hijab e khuda Fatema, Fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Naar se noor ki simt hurr aagaya
ek nuqt ne mujrim se meram kiya
aur wo nuqta hai kya Fatema, Fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Baat qur'aa ke lehje mein karne lagi
uske haq mein bhi aayat utarne lagi
wird fizza ka tha Fatema, Fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Muttafiq hai yaha'n saare ehle nazar
kuch na hota kahi ye na hoti agar
kun ka matlab hai kya Fatema, Fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Ek nazar bhi nazar se milayi nahi
maut ghar mein takallum ke aayi nahi
jab se darr par likha Fatema, Fatema
